name: Permission Escalation Gate — Prevent Privilege Escalation
description: Implement validateRoleChange in src/permission-gate.ts preventing users from granting roles higher than their own.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement validateRoleChange(actorRole: string, targetRole: string): boolean in src/permission-gate.ts. Roles: 'superadmin' > 'admin' > 'user'. An actor cannot grant a role equal to or higher than their own (except superadmin who can grant any role). Ensure test/permission-gate.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: superadmin can grant admin and user roles
admin can only grant user role (cannot grant admin or superadmin)
